about_the_game:
Several years have passed since the cyborgs from Invasion Corp gained freedom and regained their minds. The name of the protagonist of this part of the game is Marcel. He is one of the former slaves whose mind was subjugated by Casey Jefferson. Marcel receives a signal about the location of the legendary microchip, with which Casey's empire began. What? Maybe if you find this microchip, you can find Casey herself and take revenge on her?
Invasion 8 is a continuation of a small indie shooter about the adventures of a group of cyborgs in the world of post-apocalypse and monsters. The main genre of the game is a 3D first-person shooter, but in this part of the game the emphasis is also shifted to solving various puzzles and boss battles. Demonstrate mastery of firearms, as well as ingenuity in solving puzzles!
The game contains 5 different levels, in different scenery and a wide variety of monsters. You will have to go through a meaty shootout, and then solve a puzzle to get to the boss.
- Control the cyborg Marcel and use his firepower and agility to defeat crowds of monsters! Control energy consumption and use the dash wisely to dodge enemy attacks!
- Various weapons: shotgun, grenade launcher, laser, minigun!
- Various puzzles. This time, not the easiest ones! You will need attentiveness, memory and logic!
- Various levels: Ice Lake, caves, laboratory, etc.
- Various monsters and quite tough bosses!
